purpose: Compare the corrected single-pass production publication mode with the exact former post-write readback control at representative failed-run global-successor sizes before any five-node retry.

validation.after_each_timed_publish: read_bound_record exact-byte validation outside the timed interval

thresholds.derivation: The conservative required throughput factor is 59/46. The corresponding update mean is 1.739070100338624/(59/46)=1.35588516298 seconds; the frozen 1.355-second ceiling adds a small margin, and the source mode must also save at least 0.4 seconds and be at least 25 percent faster for every representative size.

next_gate: A pass is only lower-level evidence. The same S1-13 Checker must perform Phase B and separately authorize any five-node capacity retry.
